dsh-github-ops.baseUrlHint: Change it for GitHub Enterprise; the default is the public API.
dsh-github-ops.cardHint: Token from DSH credentials; settings keep only its name.
dsh-github-ops.defaultRepositoryHint: owner/repo used when a tool call omits the repository. Leave empty to always pass it explicitly.
dsh-github-ops.maxRetriesHint: A read (GET/HEAD) is retried on a network failure, a timeout or a 5xx. Writes are never retried automatically.
dsh-github-ops.panelNoAccess: No GitHub access yet: configure a credential, sign in, or use the gh CLI.
dsh-github-ops.panelPrEmptyDiff: No diff hunks available for this file.
dsh-github-ops.panelSecurityDisabled: Security features are disabled or token lacks security scope.
dsh-github-ops.prBarCopied: Instruction copied: paste it into the composer and send.
dsh-github-ops.prBarCopyFailed: Could not copy; the instruction is in the title.
dsh-github-ops.reviewRulesHint: Optional. sensitivePaths, sensitiveSeverity, attentionPaths, migrationPaths, testsRequired, sourcePatterns, testPatterns, largeDiffLines. Example: {"largeDiffLines": 400, "sensitivePaths": [".env", "private/**"]}
dsh-github-ops.scmBehindHint: Behind the upstream: sync pulls with rebase, then pushes
dsh-github-ops.scmDiffEmpty: No diff for this file (it may be binary or untracked).
dsh-github-ops.scmError: Could not read the working copy
dsh-github-ops.scmNotRepo: This workspace is not a git repository, so there is nothing to show here.
dsh-github-ops.scmNothing: Nothing to commit: the working copy is clean.
dsh-github-ops.scmRepoPathHint: Absolute path; empty means the session workspace
dsh-github-ops.statusReadOnly: Settings are read-only for this session.
dsh-github-ops.statusUnavailable: Settings service is not available in this build: values cannot be edited here.
dsh-github-ops.sub: Releases, tags, a guarded API pass-through, mirror publication and repository settings.
dsh-github-ops.timeoutMsHint: How long one GitHub request may take before it is aborted.
dsh-github-ops.title: GitHub ops
dsh-github-ops.tokenEnvHint: Name looked up in the DSH credentials, then the environment, then the gh CLI. The value is never stored here.
dsh-github-ops.tokenSourceHint: "auto" tries the DSH credential, then the environment variable, then the gh CLI session. Pin it to use one source only.
